newsitem.title: USA: U.S. energy futures firm after-hours on API data.
newsitem.headline: U.S. energy futures firm after-hours on API data.

text.p: U.S. energy futures were little changed in early after-hours trade, with no direction seen from fundamentals, traders said.
An early downturn in crude was reversed by local speculation, after-hours ACCESS traders said.
October crude oil futures traded $23.88 a barrel in early overnight discussion, off one cent from the settle on a light 300 lots.
October heating oil futures fell about 0.12 cent to 67.75 cents a gallon on 110 lots.
And as 20 lots changed hands, front-month gasoline futures edged down one point to 63.05 a gallon.
